summary: P0 BUG REPRODUCED — Lock Score parity FAILED in 4/5 random picks. rca_of_issue:
ROOT CAUSE: The Lock Score sync fix is half-applied. LockPickCard.tsx (home feed card) was patched to compute `displayLock = Math.max(pick.lock_score, pick.lock_score_v2)`. The matching change was NOT made on the Pick Detail screen (/app/frontend/app/pick/[id].tsx line 139), which still renders `Math.round(pick.lock_score)`. Additionally, the claimed backend promotion of V2 into canonical lock_score is not happening: 45/52 (87%) picks in /api/picks/today have lock_score != lock_score_v2. So the same source of truth (backend lock_score field) returns one number to the card and that same number is shown on detail — but the card overrides it with max(v1,v2), so detail and card disagree whenever v2 > v1.

REPRO: 1) login as demo@lockscore.ai. 2) GET /api/picks/today → find any pick where lock_score_v2 > lock_score (very common — happens for 45 of 52 picks). 3) On the home feed the LOCK badge shows round(max(v1,v2))=95 (or similar). 4) Tap the card → on detail page the big 78px LOCK number shows round(v1)=85. 5) User sees the same 'why won't it update' inconsistency.

MITIGATION (recommended, single line): In /app/frontend/app/pick/[id].tsx change line 139 from `{Math.round(pick.lock_score)}` to `{Math.round(Math.max(Number(pick.lock_score)||0, Number(pick.lock_score_v2)||0))}`. Test will pass immediately. Then sweep the same fix across SurvivabilityPanel/LockV2Panel/MarketRankPanel if they display lock_score anywhere visibly. Better long-term: have the backend write max(v1,v2) into lock_score at pick-generation time so the FE can drop all this defensive max() code.
